The place can get quite busy, but the food comes out quickly. It’s a simple, local spot without any fancy atmosphere, but that’s part of the experience. Great place to try authentic Vietnamese bánh xèo at a reasonable price. I’d happily come back!

Banh Seo Bao Yun Danang (Da Nang, Vietnam)
Aug 2026 • Family
On a scale of 1 to 5, I rate restaurants from a personal perspective.

【Location】3
It's at the back of the alley, but it's a single street so I don't think you'll get lost.

【Atmosphere】3
It is the kind of place that many locals go to in Da Nang. There is no air conditioning and it is not recommended to go during the day.

【Cooking】4
I think the banh seo is very good and delicious. Try to eat everything that comes out. It is delicious to eat with plenty of sauce.

【Customer service】3
There's nothing special about serving customers, but it's normal.

【Price Performance】3
This is a restaurant where you can enjoy local food in Da Nang without any worries.

【General】3
People often tell me how Michelin is, but all the shops in Da Nang are delicious. If you don't mind the details, I think the shop you pop into will become your famous.

Anyway, summer is hot in Da Nang. It is also quite harsh during the day without air conditioning. Still, I went for a delicious banh seo. I'm happy with the taste. I think it's a good shop at a reasonable price.

Other shops are open early in the morning, but please note that this one is open at 9:30.

Good Vietnamese food – hygiene may be an issue for some.
Aug 2025 • Couples
The menu is limited to about 5 dishes. We ate the traditional Vietnamese pancake (fortunately they could vary our order to exclude shrimp). It only had beef and bamboo shoots. It was crispy but bland without wrapping it in the rice paper with vegetables and then dipping it in the peanut sauce. The sauce contained pork and was very oily and flavoursome. We also had a serve of the grilled beef with some sort of leaf on top. It was delicious and went well inside our wraps with the pancake. We watched as the stainless-steel tables were barely wiped with a dirty looking towel between customers. We watched locals wiping their table with tissues upon being seated. We suggest you take some disinfectant wipes with you. Go elsewhere for more sanitary conditions and equally as good food.

Not Michelin status
Apr 2025 • Couples
The restaurant is at the end of the alley. It can be confusing because there is another banh xeo restaurant next door. Look for the green signs that say Ba Duong. The service was fast and the employees spoke English. Three stars for the banh xeo and the pork skewers. We were surprised they used whole unclean shrimp in the banh xeo. I don’t eat shrimp that way so we took them out. The pancake was also covered in loose pieces of fried eggs. The pork skewers tasted like processed meat. Not sure why they have a Michelin rating. I wouldn’t recommend this place for banh xeo or pork skewers.
